physicalNotes: Radius 0.50851994 Jupiter radii from Newton et al. 2019 (2019ApJ...880L..17N), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019ApJ...880L..17N/abstract): 36,355.1 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. No mass is measured: Benatti et al. 2019 (2019A&A...630A..81B), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019A&A...630A..81B/abstract) gives only an upper limit of 1.3 Jupiter masses, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
